channel.title: XKSH808 - Notes from the Shop
channel.description: Plain talk about getting found online, from Honolulu. Short posts, no jargon.

item.title: If It Rushes You, It's Not Your Bank
item.description: Somebody reads you a text. "Your account is locked. Tap here to verify." Is it real? Here's the test I hand out. It works almost every time. Read it out loud. Slowly. If it sounds like it's rushing you, it's not your bank.

item.title: You're Not on the List
item.description: Watch somebody look for lunch. Phone out. Two words. "Poke near me." Three names come up. Maybe four. That's the whole list. You're not on it. Nothing wrong with your food. Nothing wrong with your door. You just never claimed the little map card with your name on it. Hours nobody updated. No photos.
